what: Newton 1.6.1 SolverVBD cloth parameters for the RL env, fitted to real cloth (Coltraro IJRR 2025 free-hanging mocap, two corners scripted), plus a knit T-shirt prior. Woven numbers are validated on held-out recordings; knit numbers are a prior.

solver.particle_enable_self_contact: True in the RL env (off in the fit: free hanging)

air_model: clothilde's air model as an external force per free particle (newton_cloth.k_air): f = m*g*(1 - air_gravity_scale)*z_up - air_drag_rate_per_s*m*v, so gravity acts as air_gravity_scale*g plus linear drag; VBD has no air drag of its own

mesh_scaling.edge_ke: per hinge: edge_ke = 3*B*L/A_pair (L rest length, A_pair area of its two triangles); edge_kd = bending_tau_s * edge_ke

polyester.tag: fitted on Coltraro mocap (woven, ~1 mm markers)

cotton.tag: fitted on Coltraro mocap (woven, ~1 mm markers)

denim.tag: fitted on Coltraro mocap (woven, ~1 mm markers)

wool.tag: fitted on Coltraro mocap (woven, ~1 mm markers)

knit_tshirt_prior.tag: prior: fitted cotton x RGBench lab-measured knit/cotton ratios (geometric mean of knit class and their T-shirt); not validated on knit motion (none exists online)

friction.source: measured: Coltraro 0.48-0.80, Cloth-Var 0.40-0.68; RGBench T-shirt 0.6 cloth, 0.266 ground (tuned). VBD mixes pair friction as sqrt(mu_cloth*mu_shape)
friction.tag: measured ranges, not fitted (contact recordings cut from this step)

validation.metric: lit_marker (Coltraro eq. 10, cm) mean; rms_mm median
validation.handoff_model: physbend (bending limited to published woven range)

caveats: air model is the paper's isotropic one: gravity acts as air_gravity_scale*g (0.4-0.7) in every direction of motion. Equivalent to real weight + added mass for hanging/flinging, but on a table the friction load is also scaled, so in-plane sliding stops ~1/air_gravity_scale too late. For table phases use full gravity (air terms only matter in flings/drops) or refit a normal-direction air model (one ~20 min L4 fit)
membrane stiffness is VBD-effective, not physical: denim fits soft (tri_ke ~0.3-0.9e3 N/m) while polyester fits ~5e5; check stretch under a grasp in the interaction step
corners are point pins in the fit; real hands/hangers clamp the corner angle (both sims share this)
fitted stiffness is VBD-effective at the stated iterations/substeps: refit if those change
free-hanging motion only; bending and friction are not identified by contact recordings
Coltraro data is research-only (CC BY-NC-SA); these numbers are for our research env
contact: the stripped 2x5 setting is invalid once the gripper drags cloth; contact phases need 10x10 (~10x slower), and cloth-on-cloth in VBD is not robust (see contact.cloth_cloth)

contact.what: Contact for the RL env (2026-10-17 bench, newton_contact.py / contact_grasp.py, results/contact/). Newton 1.6.1 VBD; same on 1.7.0.

solver_setting_for_contact_phases.tag: measured: drag within ~13% of a 50-iteration reference; 5x2 / 2x5 / 5x5 / 10x5 fail (cloth does not follow the gripper, 34-44% off). The stripped 2x5 setting in fabrics_stripped is for free-hanging phases only.

contact_model.note: exclusion must stay below the layer spacing: at 3 mm two stacked sheets merged and moved as one

table_friction_correction.rule: set the pair mu to target / kappa (shape mu = (target/kappa)^2 / soft_contact_mu); kappa is constant across mu 0.1-0.2

cloth_cloth.tag: prior (JTATM 2015 / Aliouche: 0.62-0.97); VBD self-contact friction could not be calibrated (test unstable)
cloth_cloth.status: passes at 10x10 but not robust (at 50 iterations the layers move together again) - open

self_contact_speed_cap_m_s.tag: measured; penetration-free truncation by design. Keep RL cloth/gripper speeds below it

grasp.model: attach: cloth vertices inside the jaw box (pad 9 x 8 mm x jaw gap) get mass 0 and move with the jaw; release when estimated load > 2 * mu_jaw * N

squeeze_N.tag: derived: 31 public SO-101 cloth datasets (command vs measured jaw) + BAM STS3215 12 V model; contact_params.json

mu_jaw.tag: prior: pressure law (n~0.8) on 3 public plastic-fabric measurements

checks.hold_test: 4/4 (releases below 2 mu N, holds above; load estimate = hanging weight to 0.1%)
checks.geometry: single layer caught only when the jaw bottom is within ~1 mm of the table; fold edge gives single or double layers by depth

grasp.outcome_rates: prior until real SO-101 grasps calibrate them

throughput_L4.tag: measured; the bottleneck for RL at scale
